orders.thesis: Adding a seventh position, energy, to broaden the sleeve beyond the six names put on session 1 (SPY, QQQ, XLK, IWM, XLF, XLV), all of which remain above their own sma20/50/200 with the tape still risk-on per the brief's benchmark (SPY close 773.03, above sma20 751.37/sma50 747.56/sma200 703.48, 20d +3.18%). XLE closed 60.18 on 2026-08-10, above sma20 (58.32), sma50 (56.68) and sma200 (53.07) -- confirmation across all three timeframes -- with accelerating momentum (1d +4.66%, 5d +2.36%, 20d +6.06%) and sitting at 96.2% of its 52-week high (62.56). This session I opened /ticker/XLE (real DOM submit on .symbol-form, per the retry protocol -- it navigated cleanly, unlike session 1) and read its decision table: 'Price Above 200-Bar SMA' is the one rule in a FIRING state, consistent with the trend read. I also read that every one of the 11 evaluable rules on XLE rates its own statistical significance 'insufficient' (one 'weak') over a 6,952-bar/27-year sample (GET /api/rules/decisions?symbol=XLE&interval=1d) -- so I am not leaning on any single mechanical rule as a validated edge here, only on the multi-timeframe trend/momentum confirmation my own process requires, sized down accordingly.
orders.invalidation: Close back below sma20 (~58.32) ends the breakout read. The Backtest drawdown study for XLE, viewed this session, shows the current pullback peaked 2026-03-27 and troughed 2026-07-01 without a full recovery back above the March high yet -- so a failure to hold above sma50 (56.68) would mean this recovery attempt failed rather than continued, and the position should be cut regardless of where the stop sits.
